title: AcuteFindings
description: Acute and incidental findings the SOURCE itself reports (thrombus/embolism, fracture, perforation, obstruction, hemorrhage, large or increasing effusion, suspected drug pneumonitis/ILD, critical-result flags, 'please correlate clinically'). Always written — `findings: []` when a run found none, so absence of the file never reads as 'none found'. acuity comes from the fixed finding_class → default table in references/acute-findings.md, adjusted only by the source's own critical flag / urgency wording / chronic wording; it is a filing of source wording, not a clinical triage, and it does not change or replace the treating team. Written on every pass, a Phase-2-only pass on a legacy archive included: it is a safety surface, not a current-contract marker. On a current-contract archive every finding has exactly one timeline.json event with category acute_finding; on a legacy archive timeline_event_id may be null.

label.description: Short label in the source's own terms.

verbatim_text.description: Source sentence(s) verbatim; an elision is written as …… and every remaining segment must appear on the cited sidecar line(s). An ellipsis-only quote binds nothing and is rejected.

verbatim_text_search.description: Optional search form of verbatim_text when the cited born-digital sidecar lists damaged text-layer glyphs (`## 文本层字形异常`, e.g. le!t → left): verbatim_text with each listed damaged run replaced by its by-eye reading. verbatim_text itself stays the layer's characters; this field is for search and matching only (acute-findings.md §2.5). The validator recomputes it.

verbatim_is_translation.description: true when the cited sidecar holds only a Chinese rendering of a foreign-language report (acute-findings.md §2.4): verbatim_text is then that rendering, and every surface (Step 7.5, 段D) labels it a translation (中文转述，非报告原句), never the report's own words. The validator binds it both ways to that sidecar's foreign_language_paraphrase review flag. Omitted or false for a finding quoted in the report's own language.

source_ref.description: Bucket-relative sidecar anchor with a line (range), e.g. 05_影像/CT/2030-01-12_胸部CT_示例医院.md#L12.

acuity_basis.description: class_default = the fixed table value; source_critical_flag = the report prints a critical-value / critical-result mark (→ emergent); source_wording_escalation = the report's own urgency wording raises the class default; source_wording_chronic = the report states old/chronic and unchanged and already known (→ incidental).

acuity_basis_text.description: Verbatim source wording behind a non-default acuity_basis, quoted from the cited line(s) (source_ref, or acuity_basis_ref) and holding one of that adjustment's pinned words (acute-findings.md §4.1); null for class_default.

acuity_basis_ref.description: Optional: when the adjustment wording (a critical-flag note, say) sits on another line of the SAME report, its line anchor; acuity_basis_text is then bound to these lines instead of source_ref's.

verbatim.description: The source's own comparison wording (较前增多 / 无显著变化 …), on the finding's cited line(s).

direction.description: Literal mapping of the source wording only; never summarised into progression / improvement.

prior_date_stated.description: Date of the comparison study as the source states it, verbatim.

timeline_event_id.description: event_id of the timeline.json event (category acute_finding) that registers this finding. null ONLY on a legacy archive (a Phase-2-only pass before legacy_upgrade adds no acute_finding event to the legacy timeline); on a current-contract archive the validator requires the event and the two-way link.
